description: Founded and built Xpectra, a telemetry data infrastructure platform for high-rate aerospace sensor data. Took the product from 0 to 1.
highlights: Designed PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB storage with hypertables, indexing, and optimized time-window queries.
Built a rule-based anomaly engine for thresholds, outliers, flatlining, missing data, and trend detection.
Implemented real-time streaming for 20 kHz sensor data and CCSDS telemetry with live validation.
Built a low-latency visualization layer for multi-channel overlays, test comparison, and hardware root-cause analysis.
Architected a hardware-agnostic data layer supporting heterogeneous formats across evolving hardware configurations.
Built Parquet + S3 archival pipelines for scalable storage of raw and processed telemetry.

description: Shipped 3 consumer features and 1 enterprise feature within 3 months, supporting 500+ DAU and 15k+ signups. Took the product from zero to MVP, owning architecture, infrastructure, LLM agents, and core rendering logic.
highlights: Built the end-to-end backend for an AI-driven video editing platform using Python, Node.js, and AWS.
Designed Lambda & SQS based orchestration for async rendering jobs, including retries, failure handling, and status tracking.
Built LLM agent workflows to orchestrate script parsing, scene planning, and asset selection across text, image, and video generation with FFmpeg for render-ready timelines.
Integrated LiteLLM for model routing and cost control, and Langfuse for prompt versioning and agent observability.
Integrated ElevenLabs for neural voice synthesis and built audio-video alignment logic for dubbing workflows.

description: Engineered space algorithms, satellite telemetry packet decoders, multithreaded sensor fusion architectures, and SAR processing pipelines.
highlights: Developed a binary decoder for satellite packets implementing BAQ, FDBAQ, and dequantization algorithms.
Parallelised the satellite packets decoder through multiprocessing, decreasing processing time by 85%.
Architected a multithreaded framework for real-time sensor fusion processing using moodycamel circular buffers in C++.
Enhanced CUDA kernels, significantly accelerating pixel-level computational algorithms through effective parallelization.
Designed and implemented an algorithm for INS-based coordinate correction to enhance the quality of SAR images.
Refactored the Python SAR processor into a library, providing a high-level API for modular computations.
Developed the Range-Doppler algorithm for satellite SAR data and validated it using Sentinel open-source data.
Developed Docker Compose setup and automated CI/CD pipeline to build and push processor Docker images to AWS ECR.

description: Engineered gas turbine thermodynamic performance cycles, data acquisition systems, spray particle image processing, and cloud compute automation.
highlights: Designed plug-and-play Python code with modular components to build a performance cycle for any gas turbine engine.
Built a solver selection framework enabling modular integration of thermodynamic cycles and loss models.
Improved loss calculations in off-design cases by incorporating new off-design loss coefficient equations.
Built Data Acquisition Python code to acquire data of pressure sensors, air, and liquid mass flow controllers in parallel.
Developed multiprocessing Python code with OpenCV to process 1,000+ TIFF images to measure spray particle size.
Deployed Ansys on AWS EC2 high-core machines with AWS Lambda automation for instance spin-up, spot interruption handling, and S3 backup.
